title: Degendering Resumes for Fair Algorithmic Resume Screening

bias_targets.methodology: Training classification models (e.g., Tf-Idf, BigBird) on applicant resumes to predict self-reported gender, using SHAP values to identify gender-predictive features, and evaluating the trade-off between gender obfuscation (removing names, gender-indicating words, hobbies, and top predictive features) and the predictive performance of resume screening algorithms.
